Receipt Maker

Make a professional sales receipt: add line items, tax and discount, see the total live, then download or print it.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your business name and add receipt line items with quantity and price.
  2. Set the tax rate and any discount percentage.
  3. Download the .txt receipt or click Print receipt for a paper copy.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Can I list multiple items?

Yes. Enter each sold item with quantity and price, set the tax rate, and the receipt shows itemized lines, subtotal, tax and grand total.

What format is the receipt?

The download is a plain-text (.txt) receipt with clean monospace formatting, and the print button opens a print-ready page.

Is my business data uploaded anywhere?

No — it is generated entirely in your browser and never leaves your device.

How do discounts work?

Enter a negative-style discount as a percentage (0–100) in the discount field; it is subtracted after tax is added to the subtotal.
